feature: Flyer trial PR 5: Report a problem. The About index row and the form it opens (boards Report-Phone R2 and R3, Report-Desktop D2 and D3). The error screen's third link is the same form from the shell's error boundary (R1, D1).
note: Signed in, FEEDBACK_ENABLED=true for the account (the row and the link draw only then), on local-dev or a scratch branch. Writes nothing: the walk opens the form and never presses Send. The harness reaches page content inside <main> and the dialog by name, but cannot type into a portalled sheet or force a render to throw, so these states are walked by hand and pinned by component tests instead: the error screen with 'Tell us what happened' (R1, D1; a route that throws, e.g. a local-only throw in a page), the form typed (R4, D3 filled), Sending, Sent (R5, D4) and Failed with the shared toast (R6). With FEEDBACK_ENABLED off the row is absent: the Terms and Privacy line sits straight under the tiles.

rows.label: /about: the Something wrong? row under the six tiles, above Terms and Privacy
/about: Report a problem opened (sheet at 390, ModalChrome 520 at 1300), Send dim
